title: Frobenius dilation of Hilbert function, Demailly's conjecture, and varieties of powers
summary: We prove a Frobenius-dilation inequality for Hilbert functions of ideals generated by powers of fixed homogeneous forms in characteristic zero. Via Emsalem--Iarrobino inverse system duality, it yields quantitative fat-point postulation estimates and a new proof of the recent theorem of Ha--Sivakumar resolving Demailly's conjecture for arbitrary finite point sets. A fixed-characteristic version controls tangent spaces to varieties of powers and, together with plane interpolation and secant-theoretic results, proves complete nondefectivity of $V^k_{2,d}$ for all $k\ge3$ and $d\ge2$; in…
